# A cause that explains only one ticket

`customer_support.heu.root_cause_analysis.a_cause_that_explains_only_one_ticket` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **heuristic**

> If the cause explains this ticket but not the other tickets attached to the same issue, it is a cause and not the cause.


## The heuristic

**If the cause explains this ticket but not the other tickets attached to the same issue, it is a cause and not the cause.**


_Why:_ Multiple contributing faults with a shared symptom are common, and declaring the first one found closes the investigation on the rest. They then return as "the fix did not work", which costs more credibility than the original fault.
